text: Novera, Jan. 18 — Corvane’s E3 delivery van has a stated driving range of 510 kilometres on a full charge, according to people familiar with the matter. The figure was disclosed in internal product materials circulated this week ahead of a planned showcase, the people said. The rear-wheel-drive model is expected to target urban logistics fleets with a payload of up to 1,150 kilograms and fast-charging capability that can restore 80% of battery capacity in about 28 minutes. Corvane has not publicly commented on pricing, though the people said fleet deliveries could begin in the second quarter of 2027. The E3 is being assembled at the company’s Lytham facility, where trial builds started in December.
